We could also use tool to fetch data on Lakers roster and stats but no direct API for scoring leaders. Might need external knowledge. I know LeBron James was historically high scorer for Lakers (though he left). All-time leading scorer for Lakers franchise is Kobe Bryant with 33,643 points. So answer might be Kobe Bryant.
